_README: Config for copy_number.py. Paths are relative to this file. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored. Replace every value.
_genome_size: Haploid genome size of the HOST organism, in bp. Set it for the organism the line actually is.
_ploidy: Haploid equivalents per cell. Used only to convert per-haploid figures to per-cell. Measure it; do not assume 2. Many immortalised lines are aneuploid and drift on passage.
_modality: How the vector got in: nhej | integrase | transposon-pb | transposon-sb | hdr | auto. This decides whether the tandem-array estimator is valid, and it changes the site count several-fold. Confirm it against the Stage 2 fingerprint rather than taking it from the paperwork. 'auto' refuses to assume and says so in the report.
_primary_mapping: The construct whose sites you are counting.
_samples: One block per sample. dedup_pairs = deduplicated read PAIRS, from the provider summary. depth_files is the PREFERRED input: one `samtools depth -a` file per vector reference, which lets every construct be solved at once instead of estimated. detected_loci is the number of loci Stage 2 actually found, used for the reconciliation.
_mappings: One block per construct that was mapped against separately. Every name here must also be in the identity map. junctions = the TSV written by classify_junctions.py for that mapping. contig = the vector contig name inside the depth file, only needed if it differs from the construct name. mean_coverage is used ONLY by the fallback routes when no depth file is supplied; delete it once you have depth.
_calibration: OPTIONAL but valuable, and free. A locus of independently known structure, used to validate the conversion factor, the anchor assumption and the ploidy estimate at once. A single insertion on one homologue of a line with ploidy p is 1/p copies per haploid equivalent. Delete this block if you have no such locus.
